verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only marketing-level feature claims about transcription, such as '100+ languages', speaker identification and multi-language mode. It contains no documentation of the underlying transcription models, accuracy figures (e.g., WER), or known limitations. This is exactly the generic 'AI-powered' framing the story wants to see moved past, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a product manager, the vendor documents how transcription actually works and its quality (models, accuracy claims, known limits) rather than just saying "AI-powered"
